# Optional GitHub Agentic Workflows (gh-aw) track
The gh-aw CLI accepts agentic Markdown and compiles it to a GitHub Actions lockfile.
Use a supported GitHub quickstart to generate a current workflow; do not treat
this README as a runnable workflow. Begin with read-only issue triage and a safe
output that proposes a comment or new issue. Inspect the compiled workflow,
its permissions, tool list, event triggers, and generated output job. Keep direct
write permissions out of the agent job and require human review for PRs.
Official: https://github.github.com/gh-aw/introduction/overview/
